prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1492; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck while turning left. Imaging and examination were consistent with a wrist fracture, and the reported mechanism of injury corresponds well with the kind and force of the impact described. The patient completed 18 outpatient visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of fracture, reflecting a gradual course of immobilization, therapy, and reassessment. Some examination findings, including localized tenderness and reduced grip strength on the affected side, support the presence of a true injury, while other tests, such as neurovascular checks and sensation in the distal fingers, were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the patient history or available records. Review of the billing record shows no repeated or duplicate charges for services. Current assessment is a healing distal radius fracture with ongoing rehabilitation goals focused on restoring range of motion and strength.
